overview: The Razorfiend Territories are home to Luclin’s most feared predators. Their nests pulse with resonance energy, and their territorial behavior shapes the entire Tenebrous ecosystem.
history: Razorfiends have dominated the region since before vampyres or Akheva arrived.
Resonance storms have mutated several broods, creating elite variants.
Umbral Vanguard forces attempted to purge the region but failed.
Akhevan scouts avoid the Territories entirely except during ritual hunts.
hooks: A Razorfiend brood has expanded into vampyre territory.
A resonance storm mutates a Razorfiend nest.
Akhevan scouts attempt to capture a Razorfiend egg.
Umbral Vanguard forces request assistance with a brood purge.
